name: protonx-legal-tc
creator: ProtonX

card.what: Vietnamese text correction model by ProtonX that fixes OCR errors and diacritics in legal and government documents.
best_at: correcting OCR errors in scanned legal documents
restoring missing Vietnamese diacritics
normalizing government decrees and contracts
fixing punctuation and word segmentation errors
product_uses: OCR cleanup tool for scanned Vietnamese legal documents
government document normalization pipeline
contract proofreading assistant
not_for: correcting text in languages other than Vietnamese
rewriting or paraphrasing text beyond fixing errors
extracting text from images directly (needs OCR output as input)

notes: No hay categoría exacta de 'corrección de texto' en el vocabulario; se usó 'OCR and documents' por ser la más cercana (limpieza de texto ya extraído por OCR, no extracción desde imagen).
